boundary_condition: Apply only to flight departure-time-of-day selection; do not generalize it to destinations, dates, arrival times, hotel times, ground transportation, or other travel choices.
condition: When the synthetic user is searching for a flight and the current request leaves the departure time of day open, treat nighttime departure as the default preference for the relevant flight leg.
default_action: Prefer or request flight options that leave at night.
exception_condition: If the current request explicitly specifies a different departure time of day or makes a night departure unavailable or incompatible with a hard trip constraint, follow the current request instead.
name: prefers flights that depart at night
rationale: The supplied independent flight-search examples repeatedly specify leaving or flying at night. This supports a controlled synthetic-user default for flight departure time, without treating the Taskmaster speakers as one real longitudinal user.
